decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display is a flexible core format close to the established cardboard offer and costs little to keep, though it has had little visible presence since 2019.
The pegboard-back display still serves hanging-product promotions on existing production lines, but its low recent visibility suggests waning emphasis.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a staple retail format with recurring demand from brand customers.
The eighth-pallet display completes the pallet-size range and shares production with related formats, so keeping it is cheap.
The wooden pallet sits outside the cardboard core and is riskier, but it still adds range for customers wanting sturdier displays, so it stays for now under review.
